title: GNMI_GNXI Unable to set-update for Multi-asic Environment[Master,2405]
author: vikshaw-Nokia
body:
Using /root/gnxi/gnmi_cli_py/py_gnmicli.py on the PTF, we are unable to use the set-update function. While Get and Subscribe commands work for multi-ASIC setups, none of the set options function as expected.[Master,2405]
